summary: 29 features and 10 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • sessions: accept draft image refs for hagi task sessions (a0c2710)
  • claude: send chat images inline to Claude Code (2cc3382)
  • prompts: require short commit descriptions and list output (0ac4480)
  • background: store session background images as AVIF (9b56d58)
  • avatar: store custom hero avatars as AVIF (ed9423a)
  • heroes: let primary professions set Agent CLI icons (25d14da)
  • agent-icons: persist icon overrides in system config (a6bf5d2)
  • git: add git config store and project watch limit (2be75cd)
  • token-monitor: read usage from the TokenMonitor host hub (2250d69)
  • omniroute: put health probing behind an interface (b840903)
  • interactive: add custom answers and gate Reasonix questions (48f85df)
  • reasonix: report tool turns and ask user questions (c01104b)
  • acp: classify tool kinds from ACP tool updates (790487c)
  • executor: carry tool kind and identity on responses (b1edae8)
  • tools: project tool calls into a shared envelope (86f024e)

HagiCode-org/web

  • preset-task: bulk select repositories in the task drawer (014f39d)
  • proposal: add bulk select and permission to repository picker (0ed351b)
  • preset-task: attach composer images to the first message (6f693a2)
  • chat: flag attachments that may be converted before sending (ac846c5)
  • wizard: hide MonoSpecs hints in the first-run project step (30f8186)
  • statusbar: count TokenMonitor levels above one billion (0471cbb)
  • hero: show the bound CLI corner badge on rail members (3291984)
  • omniroute: auto-save OmniRoute settings (53390db)
  • hydration: fill the droplet by remaining break time (546d10c)
  • statusbar: animate TokenMonitor increments and progress (91701e4)
  • token-monitor: read usage from HostHub with a file fallback (6093efc)
  • conversation: render tool results through per-kind displays (73dcf9b)
  • hero: edit Agent CLI and profession icons in hero settings (1d655ae)
  • executor: add Agent CLI icons with a monogram fallback (f795ab4)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • mapper: stop storing base64 data of user images (a4734de)
  • storage: open the connection before creating the command (8d194c4)
  • favorites: keep stored name when an update leaves it blank (26f2949)

HagiCode-org/web

  • markdown: drop hast node prop and nested list whitespace (1741581)
  • preset-task: reset drawer fields before the first paint (2d70f2a)
  • settings: confirm system reset in a nested Radix dialog (2aa14f8)
  • hero: return available names when the batch name pool is empty (2464c82)
  • wizard: open past a snooze when no crew or project is usable (bd2da75)
  • tool-call: show readable result text as command stdout (b963524)
  • tool-call: read image result details from the envelope (3d76083)
